row: The University of Tennessee Veterinary Educational Television channel was created to share information about veterinary medicine, the UT College of Veterinary Medicine and the UT Veterinary Medical Center. Located on the UT agricultural campus in Knoxville, is one of only 33 accredited veterinary colleges in the country. For more information, visit https://vetmed.tennessee.edu
